description: A vale ringed by impassable peaks, with one town, Lastward, and the ruins of Harrowmere: its streets, three levels of sewers, and the Warden's six-floor tower, trapped and guarded on every floor. One pass leads out, held by five bound posts, each worse than the last; the outermost wants a party of 15th level. No quests, factions, or raids.

specials.text: Harrowmere. The town drowned in ash and was never dug out. Doors hang open on every street, and something has been nesting in the houses.
The Warden's Tower rises six floors over the rooftops. Its doors are bricked shut from inside. Lastward's old men say the sewers run under its cellar.
A chapel of the Lady. Her statue was pulled down long ago, and the bound dead kneel where it stood.
The sewer works. A grate stands open in the floor, and the stink of the tunnels comes up through it.
A strongbox under the guildhall's floor, its ledger rotted to a black cake.
A dry corner with one way in, out of the wind and the water. The party could rest here.
The door bars from inside, and nothing has scratched at it in a long while. A place to camp.
Old bedrolls and a cold fire ring: someone rested here before, and lived to leave.
